summary: The myseliasan fleet agent can now answer questions about how the products work, not only about what the fleet is doing. A new app-agnostic retrieval library (domain/shared/manual/retrieval) indexes the suite's built-in manuals in memory -- sections split on the same '## Heading {#anchor}' boundaries the contextual help already deep-links to, ranked with BM25 plus a topic boost for a query term found in a section's heading, title or slug, over a tokenizer built for all four shipped languages: character bigrams for Chinese (which has no word delimiters, so a whitespace split retrieves nothing at all), diacritic/tatweel/alef folding plus light clitic stripping for Arabic (without which a reader's query and the article that answers it can share not one byte), and English plural/verb-form folding so that 'how do I add a camera' reaches the article titled 'Adding cameras'. myseliasan carries BOTH its own manual and mymatasan's, because a control plane is where operators ask questions about software running on other machines; every citation names the product it documents. Ask-the-fleet now appends up to three retrieved sections to its grounding, under a prompt that separates 'what this fleet is doing now' from 'how the software works in general', and the SSE stream gained an 'event: sources' frame carrying which sections the finished answer actually cited -- rendered in the SPA as chips that open the help drawer for this app's own manual and name the product for the other's. A new GET /api/agent/docs returns the same ranked sections with snippets and needs NO language model, so the help half of the assistant works on the default appliance where no model is configured: the chat card now offers manual search instead of only 'the LLM is disabled'.
compatibility: Backward compatible, additive only. No config keys, schema, migrations or existing routes changed; the new GET /api/agent/docs sits under the existing /api/agent endpoint-catalog row (AuthOnly), so no new seed row and no permission-matrix change is needed and existing grants cover it. Retrieval is pure Go over already-embedded markdown -- no new module dependencies, no model, no download, no store, no index to rebuild or back up, and nothing that touches the network (the air-gap posture is unchanged). Indexing is lazy and per language, so a control plane whose operator never asks a question pays nothing. Two internal Go signatures changed for callers inside this repo only: services.NewChatService and apis.NewAgentApi take a *DocsService, and ChatService.Stream now returns (llm.ChatResult, []DocExcerpt, error). myseliasan's binary grows by roughly 700 KB of embedded markdown (mymatasan's manual in four languages) -- this is the suite's only cross-app Go import, deliberately confined to one file that imports a content-plus-embed package with no services, config or init work.
